source: Manual mapping of CES tenant-test probes to NIST SP 800-171A assessment objectives (determination statements).
method: A probe lists an objective ONLY when its Script genuinely Examines that determination statement (queries tenant config and its PASS condition is direct evidence the statement is true). Hardcoded 'platform-provided' PASSes and SKIPPED probes Examine nothing -> objectives:[]. Controls use stripped ids; objectives use full catalog ids + letter. Match is on the numeric part (e.g. AC-3.1.5 == AC.L2-3.1.5).

summary.g_fw_alt_note: 2026-07-04: +3 from UC-G F-LABEL resolution (MP-3.8.2[a], MP-3.8.4[a][b] now PASS via D-11 label protection); +13 from G-FW-ALT Phase 2 (UC-H boundary probes SC-3.13.1[c][d][e][f][g][h], SC-3.13.6[a][b], SI-3.14.6[a][b][c] + UC-E flow-analytics augment). The UC-H/flow objectives are examined-when-run: probes return INCONCLUSIVE with a named gap until customer VNets exist (vfsgov has none today; they activate with enclave compute per G-FW-ALT Phase 1).
summary.phase2_note: G-EUT-5 Phase 2a fixed the two miscredited probe sets: IA-3.5.1 (users/processes/devices identified) and AC-3.1.7 (privileged functions defined/prevented/audited) now genuinely examine their determinations (85 -> 92). Phase 2b added six objective-depth probes: AC-3.1.5[c][d] (all priv assignments), IR-3.6.1[e] (containment automation), AC-3.1.20[a][c] (external connections identified/verified), CM-3.4.1[d][e] (system inventory), CM-3.4.2[a] (security settings established), IA-3.5.6[a][b] (inactivity disable) (92 -> 102).
